Free profile access

Get free access to manage your public profile on Franklin Navigator.

Start with the exact public profile, then create or sign in to your Franklin account and confirm that you are authorized to manage it. If you arrived from a profile page, that profile stays selected through sign-in. No membership or payment is required.
